consumption.description: Month total meter consumption including coefficient.

isShared.description: Changing from TRUE to FALSE will result in all existing RoomMeters being deleted

entityId.description: If entity is present, type from entity overrides typeCode

reading.description: Month latest reading from meter. Or consumption must be present.

consumption.description: Month total meter consumption including coefficient. Or reading must be present.

tenantId.description: Building and Room Id's must be filled to use tenantId.

customFields.description: Map of custom field definition ID to value. Value type depends on field type: TEXT/TEXT_AREA -> String, BOOLEAN -> Boolean, SELECT -> Long (option ID)
Map of custom field definition ID to value. Value type depends on field type: TEXT/TEXT_AREA -> String, BOOLEAN -> Boolean, SELECT -> Long (option ID)

mentions.description: User is made a participant of chat if not already.

participantGroupType.description: Use this when external needs to create a chat, but there is no supervisor assigned yet.

participants.description: First participant in list is considered as the chat initiator.

filesCount.description: Count of chat files that are not related to a message.

value.description: Value is output as instance of valueType.

unAnswered.description: Null when satisfaction query has been submitted or is no longer permitted.

answered.description: Null when satisfaction query is permitted and not submitted yet.

tenantId.description: Building and Room Id's must be filled to use tenantId.

customFields.description: Map of custom field definition ID to value. Value type depends on field type: TEXT/TEXT_AREA -> String, BOOLEAN -> Boolean, SELECT -> Long (option ID)

fileName.description: The file key returned by the upload url request.

url.description: S3 signed url from where the file can be downloaded

active.description: When true, returns only currently ongoing leases.

activeBetweenStart.description: Filter by lease active between dates, required both start and end dates

activeBetweenEnd.description: Filter by lease active between dates, required both start and end dates

endDate.description: NULL when the period is open-ended.

periods.description: Lease activity periods overlapping the requested period.

isVisibleToTenant.description: Filter by tenant visibility. When true, returns only tickets whose action is marked as visible to tenant.

roomIds.description: Filter by ticket room ids, uses OR

statuses.description: Filter by ticket status, uses OR

buildingIds.description: Filter by ticket building, uses OR

roomIds.description: Filter by ticket room, uses OR

categoryIds.description: Filter by ticket category, uses OR

createdOrModifiedAfter.description: Filter by ticket created or modified date after. UTC time, timezone is not taken into account.

customFields.description: Filter by custom field values. Key is custom field definition ID, value is list of matching values.

uploadUrl.description: Url where file can be uploaded to s3

fileName.description: File key that should be posted after successful upload

name.description: Filter by building name or building owner name

search.description: Filter by a list of search terms. Terms compared to address components including building name.

tenantId.description: Filter by tenant id. Returns results where tenant has active contract on building room.

states.description: Filter by room state, uses OR

types.description: Filter by room types, uses OR

tenantId.description: Filter by tenant id. Returns rooms where tenant has current contract on room.

search.description: Filter by meter name, meter type, room name, tenant name.

types.description: Filter by classifier codes, uses OR

hasParentMeter.description: Filter by meter has parent meter

entityIds.description: Filter by entity id, uses OR

meterHasRoom.description: Filter by meter is related to room

meterNotDeleted.description: Filter by meter is not deleted

roomIds.description: Filter by being related to at least one Room Id

activePeriod.description: Filter by meter not being archived in requested period.

Authentication.description: All requests must be accompanied with Bearer token in the form of JWT
